configuration.region_schedule: seed offset cycles all legal Germany/3p region sets

eligibility.criterion: overall candidate score > 0.50, seed-cluster 95% CI lower bound > 0.50, and both composition point scores >= 0.50

method.confidence_interval: seed-cluster bootstrap; every sampled seed keeps all six lineups
method.lineup_schedule: both 2v1 compositions and every seat placement
method.score: candidate wins + 0.5 * draws over cross-checkpoint seat pairs
method.tie: equal powered cities, money, and connected cities
